'''Quirt's prison ship''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Prison ship/Legends|prisoner transport]] commanded by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Quirt]].

==History==
Quirt used the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to gather up criminals on [[Formos/Legends|Formos]] and transport them to the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. It caught the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] as it attempted to escape Formos with a shipment of spice. Quirt was fooled by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and uncovered no spice nor the escaped [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] [[Hronk]] and subsequently let the ship go.
